title: IR lazy-dispatch source ownership and public mapping mutability
author_role: Local candidate author; not independent code acceptance, integration publication, or formal finding adjudication

question_for_G.question: Are the publicly exported IR facade dictionaries an intentional, supported mutation/extension API, or are they read-only source manifests whose runtime set must remain source-owned?
question_for_G.recommendation: For the required finite source-owned dispatch property, treat the maps as read-only manifests and freeze the entire IR lazy-facade quantity. If G does not authorize the public API migration, preserve the current behavior and keep the static source proof explicitly held/non-green.
question_for_G.decision_boundary: This is a public-API compatibility choice. The runtime probes establish mutable Python behavior; they do not establish that external clients rely on or are entitled to mutation. No external-client census was performed.

property_and_divergence.required_property: The six IR PEP 562 facades dispatch only through a complete, source-owned, deterministic manifest, while preserving the declared public import surface and actual package submodule behavior.
property_and_divergence.current_implementation: The exported facade maps are mutable dictionaries. Runtime resolution consults them, caches resolved namespace values, derives dir/facade names from them, and separately falls back to real package submodules for names absent from curated maps.
divergent_cases: Adding a symbol after import changes resolution, dir(), and facade_export_names(), while __all__ remains the import-time snapshot.
Remapping before first access changes the resolved object; remapping after access leaves the cached object unchanged.
Removing a name fails with AttributeError, while an absent curated name can still resolve as a real submodule such as analytics.causal_graph.
The static export reader returns an incomplete inventory for these import-driven facades; it does not falsely report a complete runtime set.
property_and_divergence.impact_boundary: The demonstrated divergence concerns API/inventory determinism and source-analysis completeness. No policy authority or admissibility decision is shown to depend on these maps.
property_and_divergence.capability_status: The bounded lazy-import runtime route is exercised, but the source-owned closed-dispatch proof remains verification_missing/held. This packet does not claim an E02 capability closure.

alternatives.approach: Reuse current behavior and retain a bounded residual.
alternatives.impact: No migration or source change. Keep public dict behavior, report static closed-source dispatch as unresolved, and do not claim the Phase6 dynamic-import gate is green.

alternatives.approach: Extend with a canonical source-owned immutable IR dispatch manifest that is the actual runtime admission source.
alternatives.impact: Preferred narrow mechanism if G selects read-only manifests. Preserve current public names, key/target pairs, owner identity, lazy loading, and package fallback; update API typing and schema catalog to Mapping. Add whole-quantity mutation/removal/fallback tests and complete source-gate proof.
alternatives.status: recommended conditional on G compatibility decision; not implemented

alternatives.approach: Consolidate duplicate declarations into one canonical table with compatibility projections.
alternatives.impact: Potentially reduces drift but crosses map identity, __all__, dir, memoization, reflection, and fallback contracts. Consider only after G chooses the public mutation policy; no prototype demonstrates transparent compatibility.

alternatives.approach: Build a runtime registration/plugin ABI or general importer interpreter.
alternatives.impact: A writable registry would need synchronization of mutation, __all__, dir, caches, schema reflection, and consumers; a general interpreter/source execution adds unsafe complexity. IR is documented as not a plugin host and no registration contract exists.
alternatives.status: not recommended/rejected for this bounded decision

compatibility_and_migration.public_api_status: polisyos.ir is classified public_stable and polisyos.ir.api is listed as a public entrypoint.
compatibility_and_migration.documented_policy: The Python public API policy names team-architecture as version owner, allows a two-minor-release deprecation window, and requires a breaking signal via SemVer major or an explicit shim/deprecation entry.
compatibility_and_migration.decision_required: G must choose whether to stage deprecation before rejecting writes or to deliver an explicit breaking release/shim. This author packet does not pick a release version, imply existing deprecation, or authorize an unannounced behavior/type change.
proposed_migration_if_read_only_is_selec: Before implementation, publish the chosen deprecation/major-release path and owner assignment with team-polisyos for the IR surface and team-architecture for public API versioning.
Keep the existing aliases, exported names, target tuples, and lazy behavior during any approved deprecation period; do not advertise mutation as a registry unless G explicitly chooses that contract.
At the approved compatibility boundary, expose immutable Mapping values as the runtime dispatch source and update resolver/type/catalog consumers and generated public-surface artifacts together.

Verify all six facade routes, import identity, __all__/dir behavior, cache behavior, mapping mutation refusal, unknown-name behavior, real analytics child-module fallback, schema reflection, and the direct DEFAULT_UNITS_REGISTRY consumer.
compatibility_and_migration.persisted_data_or_law_migration: None identified. This decision changes a Python public API contract only; it supplies no law, issuer, permission, or authority fact.
compatibility_and_migration.status_time_authority: No expiry, blanket waiver, or clock-based exception is proposed. G adjudication remains pending; no authority or closure is created by this packet.

pattern_pass.anti_pattern_found: A public mutable dispatch table is treated as a static source manifest although runtime consumers observe mutation, caching, reflection, and a separate package fallback. A single analytics-only fix would be instance-patching.
pattern_pass.target_pattern: One source-owned runtime dispatch contract for the full IR quantity, with explicitly bounded submodule fallback and truthful incomplete/held gate status until the complete source proof passes.
pattern_pass.acceptance_signal: After G chooses compatibility semantics, an independent review verifies whole-surface behavior/removal controls and the real dynamic-import source gate completes its entire denominator on frozen source.
